content: The remainder of this paper is organised as follows. Section 2 briefly describes task-oriented dialogue. Section 3 describes the motivation for the NUS and discusses related work. Section 4 explains the structure of the NUS, how it is trained and how it is deployed for training a DM's policy. Sections 5 and 6 present the experimental setup and results. Finally, Section 7 gives conclusions.
